shift_pattern: Rotational 10AM-10PM, 5 days a week, weekend availability required
salary_range: Rs 20,000 - Rs 26,000 per month plus incentive up to Rs 4,000

screening_questions.text: How many years have you worked in retail or customer-facing sales?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: The role requires at least one year of customer-facing experience.

screening_questions.text: Are you comfortable speaking with customers in Kannada?
Can you work on weekends, which are our busiest days?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: Weekend cover is mandatory for this role.

screening_questions.text: Are you comfortable standing for a full shift on the shop floor?
screening_questions.why_it_matters: The role is on the shop floor throughout the shift.

screening_questions.text: Which store is easier for you to reach, Indiranagar or Koramangala?

facts_the_agent_may_state: The role is retail sales associate at our Indiranagar and Koramangala stores in Bengaluru.
Pay is Rs 20,000 to Rs 26,000 per month.
There is a monthly store-level sales incentive of up to Rs 4,000.
Shifts are rotational between 10 AM and 10 PM, five days a week with two rotating weekly offs.
Weekend availability is required because weekends are the busiest days.
Provident fund and ESI are provided as per statute.
Staff receive a 30 percent discount on all merchandise.
The role requires at least one year of retail, hospitality or customer-facing sales experience.
Duties include greeting customers, explaining products, billing, restocking and month-end stock counts.
